provenance: PR #23 round 1 R1/R2. The initial TinBoker restyle kept the empty page within 390px but did not exercise a rendered trace target: 90 unbroken characters expanded the document to 665px. The light placeholder also mixed --dim at 82% with transparency, rendering at 3.61:1 against the paper-terminal input background. This browser case renders the actual stepEl output in both color schemes and measures document width plus the effective computed placeholder color. PR #23 R5: the case opted out of ADR-013 Decision 1 — it started its own Playwright driver and launched its own Chromium on every invocation, which measured 0.291 / 0.293 / 0.288s against 0.076 / 0.074 / 0.075s through the suite's shared browser, on a suite whose committed gate run had just breached the 60s ceiling at 60.28s. Moved onto `_browser()` + a per-scheme `new_context(viewport=..., color_scheme=...)` on the shared `_LOOP`; both mutation reds were re-verified afterwards and are unchanged — emptying `.hd > code { min-width:0; overflow-wrap:anywhere }` gives dark and light `document_width` 665 against `inner_width` 390, and a placeholder of `color-mix(in srgb, var(--dim) 60%, transparent)` gives contrast 3.28 dark / 2.42 light against the 4.5 minimum.

triage.note: Narrow responsiveness and contrast must be checked in the populated UI, not inferred only from static container widths and opaque palette tokens.
